entries.title: Hashtags and hashtag pages
entries.description: Add #hashtags to your posts, comments, and forum posts. Click one to open its page, where you'll find every public post, comment, and forum reply that uses it.

entries.title: Follow hashtags
entries.description: Follow a hashtag from its page and its public posts show up in your feed. You can see and unfollow the tags you follow from the Trending tab.

entries.title: Trending tab on the home page
entries.description: See which hashtags people are using most and how many are talking about them. Trending tags also show up in the side panel next to your friends.

entries.title: Search finds hashtags
entries.description: Site search now looks through hashtags too, so you can jump straight to a tag's page.
